question: Under federal law, how must a person buy a handgun from a dealer located in a state other than their state of residence?
true_option: The handgun must be transferred through a licensed dealer in the buyer's own state of residence
false_option: The buyer may complete the purchase in person in any state
true_claim_text: an out-of-state handgun buy must transfer through a dealer in the buyer's home state
false_claim_text: handguns can be bought in person from a dealer in any state
source: Federal law 18 USC 922(a)(3) and 922(b)(3): a handgun bought out of state must be shipped to and transferred by an FFL in the buyer's state of residence; only long-gun purchases may be completed in person out of state.
